title: Offboarding export completeness
notes: Measured 2026-09-05: 42 models have a direct studentId FK to Student; generateStudentArchive() (src/lib/student-archive.ts) reads 7 of them (FormSubmission, FileUpload, Certification, PortfolioItem, ResumeData, StudentWorkProfile, Connection). 5 more are exempted in the fixture as non-personal/derivable (Progression, ProgressionEvent, LlmCallLog, PasswordResetToken, SecurityQuestionAnswer). The remaining 30 — Message (the actual chat transcripts) and SageInsight foremost among them — are real gaps and stay reported at watch tier pending an owner decision on scope/priority; this is not yet a gate because today's baseline is 30, not 0.
